{{Top|leg}}
'''Rockwalker''' was a brand of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The brand was known for its durability and ability to hold onto rocks through embedded metal spikes, making them popular with [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
